The '''lava skimmer''' was a pole-mounted cauldron and used by the [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to collect lava from the planet's natural lava streams. These devices served as both crucible tongs and pouring shanks.

Lava skimmers consisted of a lava-proof metal shank tipped with a ratchet clamp with pressure-stop lock. This clamp could hold a lava-resistant ceramic cauldron, in which lava could be held. Southern Mustafarians had evolved powerful bodies, and were thus able to lift these heavy devices.

"Lava skimmer" was also a term used to describe those Mustafarians who employed these devices in their mining operations.
